come and �nd peace in the lord. also on the first saturday of every month- devotions in clara church at 2.55pm. everyone welcome to attend. join us for evena brief period of time. the commandments of love. in our gospel this week when jesus was asked which was the greatest commandment of the law of moses, he answered, not with his own words or ideas, but with the words of god to moses and with the words he himself, as a jewi shman, prayed twice each day. we hear them in the gospel as god’s word to us as christians. if we are being called in our present world to do one thing – then it has to be the call to proclaim love and hope in a world increasingly hearing calls to and fear. all around us, in midterm elections, in riots in european cities, in wars ravaging whole regions of our world, in tariff wars, in soaring gas and diesel prices, in rising inflation and cost of living, leaders and politicians and those with vested int erests in unrest and polarisation, sow seeds of hate and use fear as a we apon to divide people. never before has this gospel been more pertinent and relevant to our times. we live within a divided and fearful world, but we should not give our alleg iance to a divided and fearful world. our allegiance is to the kingdom of god; the kingdom won for us by jesus; the kingdom w here death is conquered by resurrection, hate is conquered by love, and fear is conquered by hope; the kingdom where we can “love the lord our god with all our heart, and with all our soul, and with all our mind… and love our neighbour as ourselves.” collections 17th/18th october – development fund: €960 ; mission sunday: €1,415 ; october offerings: €685 . thank you very much!
